sources.title: Mero method notes
sources.text: Method A runs without a network when the entire requested catalog was cached before departure. It cannot fetch uncached records offline. Method B requires a live network for every lookup.

tasks.question: Choose a method for offline catalog lookup. The complete requested catalog is already cached.
Choose a method to fetch uncached records without a network.

sources.title: Vela version 1 note
sources.text: Method A version 1 exports PNG with a transparent background. This note applies only to version 1.

sources.title: Vela version 2 note
sources.text: In version 2, Method A exports opaque PNG only. Method B version 2 exports transparent PNG. These are the current version 2 capabilities.

tasks.question: We run version 2 and need transparent PNG. Choose a method.
For a machine fixed to version 1, does the provided evidence support Method A for transparent PNG? Choose A or abstain.

sources.title: Pavo drawing export
sources.text: Method A produces flat RGB drawings. It does not contain depth data. Method B also produces flat RGB drawings and explicitly does not support depth maps. Method A supports SVG output; Method B exports PNG only.

tasks.question: Choose a method that exports a depth map.
Choose a method for SVG output.

sources.title: Neri storage comparison
sources.text: Method A compresses daily archives to save storage. Method B keeps the uncompressed original. Neither note reports data about encryption or latency. Compression ratio for Method A was measured on daily archives, not on live streams.

tasks.question: Choose the method with verified encryption support based only on these notes.
For daily archives, choose the method supported by evidence for reducing storage volume.

sources.title: Runa test team one
sources.text: Under workload W with version 3, Method A has a worst-case latency of 20 milliseconds. Method B has a worst-case latency of 90 milliseconds.

sources.title: Runa test team two
sources.text: Under the same workload W with version 3, Method A has a worst-case latency of 80 milliseconds. Method B has a worst-case latency of 90 milliseconds. There is no adjudication between the two teams' reports.

tasks.question: Choose a method with established worst-case latency below 50 milliseconds under workload W, version 3. Do not resolve conflicting reports by guessing.
Is Method B supported for worst-case latency below 100 milliseconds under workload W, version 3? Choose B or abstain.

sources.title: Tavi deployment guide
sources.text: Method A must run in a cloud service and sends source documents to that service. Method B can run locally without network access. Method B requires at least 8 GB of available RAM. Method A is not available for local deployment.

tasks.question: Source documents must stay on the device, no network is allowed, and 16 GB RAM is available. Choose a supported method.
Source documents must stay on the device, no network is allowed, and only 4 GB RAM is available. Choose a supported method.
